XLR cables (pool)

Category
cable
Quantity
20
Status
active
Location
Cable bag under the sound booth

Notes

A mix of 10-ft, 25-ft, and 50-ft XLR cables. Replace any cable that fails the "wiggle test" at the connector.

Cables are the most common failure point. Always keep at least three spare XLR cables in the booth.

  • XLR cable on channel 4 crackling (open)
